title: Bar Drop Lemon Lime 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Lemon Lime is a sharp and invigorating citrus combination that balances bright acidity with subtle sweetness. The inhale provides the zesty, vibrant tang of fresh Lemon, which is perfectly complemented by the slightly sweeter, aromatic notes of Lime on the exhale. This double-concentrated formulation ensures the citrus profile is exceptionally clear, delivering a clean and refreshing taste experience with every puff. Formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, this e-liquid is specifically designed for MTL/RDL vaping. When paired with stater vape kits and low-wattage tanks, it produces small vapour clouds alongside exceptional flavour clarity. The even consistency ensures optimal wicking and performance in MTL/RDL devices, providing a smooth and satisfying experience. The Bar Drop Shortfill collection takes the intensely concentrated flavour profiles typically found in "bar salt" ranges and presents them in a 50%-VG format. Supplied as 50ml of nicotine-free e-liquid in a 60ml bottle, there is space to add a single 10ml nicotine shot, allowing you to easily create 60ml of 3mg e-liquid. This offers a cost-effective and highly flavoursome solution for sub-ohm vapers.
